same_support: Identical graph, POI catalog, origins, residential and <=100 m connection filters. Each objective may choose a different nearest candidate within a category.
time_distance_equivalence: At fixed 1.2 m/s, shortest walking-time and shortest-distance routes are equivalent. Mean shortest distance in meters = mean baseline minutes ×72.
important: Stronger shade coefficients and finer edge-local tree features are a chosen scenario, not evidence of improved human preference accuracy. Percentile-change colors use their own clearly labeled signed scale. Model-equivalent minutes are not actual walking duration.
